system_name: realbench DeepSeek V4 Pro harness snapshot

published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned publication executes released coding-agent CLIs through thin shell wrappers. OpenCode and Pi target DeepSeek V4 Pro directly with the same DeepSeek API-key source; the Claude Code arm uses the DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible proxy and its native telemetry also reports DeepSeek V4 Flash sub-agent calls. W1 preserves those source-level differences and does not adjudicate historical canonical linkage.

execution.environment: Apple M2 Max; 12 CPU cores; 32 GB RAM; macOS 26.2 (25C56); local APFS SSD
execution.evaluator: task-local deterministic verify.sh; verifier hashes protect benchmark-owned files
execution.reset_policy: fresh task workspace copy per run; _reference is not copied into the working directory; separate process tree per run
execution.model_configuration: direct DeepSeek V4 Pro; no explicit reasoning-effort pin is present in the pinned wrapper

observations.notes: The curator keeps the first five valid English-prompt records per public agent/task cell after the documented prompt-language cutoff and drops runner-infrastructure records that never reached an agent/verify exit code. Agent timeouts remain failures.
